title: Can, Could & Would

expressions.expr: Could you do me a favor?
expressions.meaning: Você poderia me fazer um favor?
expressions.example: Could you do me a favor and send me the file?
Would you like to join us? I would love to!

expressions.expr: I can't afford it right now.
expressions.meaning: Não posso pagar por isso agora.
expressions.example: It's a great trip but I can't afford it right now.
Would you mind closing the window? It's cold.

sentences: I can handle a lot of pressure at work.
I would love to work abroad one day.
Could you help me with this problem?
He would choose a different career now.
There are many options — which would you prefer?
I can't afford much this month.

grammar.title: Can / Could / Would — Modais Essenciais
rules: CAN: habilidade presente / permissão → "I can speak English." / "Can I leave early?"
COULD: habilidade passada / pedido educado → "I could swim as a child." / "Could you help me?"
WOULD: hipotético / desejo / pedido formal → "I would love to." / "Would you like coffee?"
MANY: substantivos contáveis → "many books, many people, many options"
MUCH: substantivos incontáveis → "much time, much money, much work"
A LOT OF: ambos → "a lot of books / a lot of time"

rows: A lot of work to do.

quiz.q: ___ you help me with this report?
